fiche: Petit automate de bronze né d'un boulon oublié, il trottine dans les ateliers abandonnés en quête de vis à serrer.
apparence: Small round clockwork automaton with a riveted bronze shell, a single glowing crystal eye and a wind-up key on its back; bronze, steel grey and cyan crystal glow.

stades.bebe: A round bronze bolt-head body with one huge cyan crystal eye, tiny stub feet and a little wind-up key on top.
stades.enfant: Short jointed steel arms with pincer hands sprout from the sides and the wind-up key moves to its back.
stades.ado: The body stretches into an egg shape with longer piston legs, a wrench-shaped right hand and a riveted chest plate.
stades.adulte: A sturdy bronze automaton with broad gear shoulders, a wrench arm and a screwdriver arm, and a cyan crystal core glowing through a chest grille.
stades.ancien: A stooped bronze automaton with green patina, a monocle lens over its eye, a cane made of a long bolt and a slowly turning brass key.

fiche: Chiot de ferraille rouillée qui fouille les décharges et ronge les vieilles chaînes comme des os.
apparence: Dog-like scrap-metal construct made of rusty plates, chains and a tin-can head with a glowing amber grille mouth; rust orange, dull iron and amber glow.

stades.bebe: A round tin can with big amber lamp eyes, four tiny spring legs and a short bolt tail.
stades.enfant: Floppy sheet-metal ears and a hinged jaw with a grille mouth appear, and the tail becomes a little chain.
stades.ado: The body lengthens into a barrel torso with jointed iron legs, a padlock collar and a spiky gear on its back.
stades.adulte: A muscular scrap hound with overlapping rusty armor plates, a heavy vice-grip jaw, gear spines along the back and a long whipping chain tail.
stades.ancien: An old scrap hound covered in moss and flaking rust, with a drooping metal moustache, a lantern hanging from its collar and polished veteran rivets.

fiche: Marionnette de bois enchantée qui danse seule dans les théâtres en ruine, ses fils reliés à rien.
apparence: Enchanted wooden puppet with ball joints, painted face and loose golden strings floating upward from its limbs; varnished wood, crimson paint and gold thread.

stades.bebe: A round wooden ball head with big painted eyes, rosy cheeks and a tiny peg body hanging from one golden string.
stades.enfant: Jointed wooden arms and legs on visible ball joints appear, each tied to a floating golden thread.
stades.ado: The puppet grows a slender body with a crimson painted jacket, a pointed jester collar and a hinged smiling jaw.
stades.adulte: A tall graceful puppet knight with carved wooden armor, a thin wooden rapier, a crimson cape and many golden strings rising like a crown.
stades.ancien: An old cracked puppet with faded paint, a long carved wooden beard, patched joints and a glowing halo of tangled golden threads.

fiche: Serpent d'acier fait d'un ressort enchanté, il rebondit entre les rochers des canyons en sifflant comme une bouilloire.
apparence: Snake construct made of a coiled steel spring body with a polished copper head and a pink energy crystal in the forehead; steel, copper and magenta crystal.

stades.bebe: A short fat coil of steel spring with a round copper head, big eyes and a tiny crystal dot on the forehead.
stades.enfant: The coil gets longer and a hinged copper jaw with two small rivet fangs appears.
stades.ado: Copper fin plates grow along the spring body and the tail ends in a sharp drill tip.
stades.adulte: A long powerful spring serpent with an armored copper cobra hood, a large magenta crystal on its brow and a spinning drill tail.
stades.ancien: An ancient spring serpent with green patina on its hood, a frayed copper whisker beard and small crystals growing along its coils.

fiche: Petit gardien de pierre taillée qui veille sur les entrées des temples et dort la journée en se faisant passer pour une statue.
apparence: Turtle-like stone guardian made of carved grey blocks held by bronze bands, with glowing blue rune lines; grey stone, bronze and blue rune glow.

stades.bebe: A round pebble with two big glowing blue eyes and four tiny stone nub feet.
stades.enfant: A carved stone shell with one blue rune appears on its back, and a small square head pokes out.
stades.ado: The shell becomes stacked stone blocks bound by bronze bands, and the legs become thick carved pillars.
stades.adulte: A heavy stone guardian with a temple-roof shell covered in blue runes, a lion-like carved stone face and pillar legs.
stades.ancien: A weathered stone guardian with moss and small flowers on its shell, a cracked stone beard and a tiny shrine bell hanging from its jaw.

fiche: Lanterne de cuivre animée qui flotte dans les galeries sombres pour guider les voyageurs égarés.
apparence: Floating copper lantern construct with glass panes and a living flame crystal inside; copper, smoked glass and warm yellow glow.

stades.bebe: A tiny round copper lamp with a single glass window showing two big glowing eyes and a small hanging ring on top.
stades.enfant: Two small copper handle arms appear on the sides and the flame inside gets a happy face.
stades.ado: The lamp grows into a hexagonal lantern with tinted glass panes and a chain tail dangling below.
stades.adulte: A large ornate copper lantern with spiked crown top, four glowing glass panes, chain arms ending in hooks and a bright crystal flame heart.
stades.ancien: An old dented lantern with soot-stained glass, a curling copper beard of melted metal and a soft halo of floating sparks.

fiche: Mille-pattes d'engrenages qui ronronne dans les machineries des usines oubliées et répare tout ce qu'il traverse.
apparence: Centipede construct made of linked brass gears with needle legs and a lens-eyed head; brass, black iron and green crystal glow.

stades.bebe: A single round brass gear with big lens eyes and four tiny needle legs underneath.
stades.enfant: Two more gear segments link behind the head and small antennae made of springs appear.
stades.ado: The body grows to many turning gear segments with pairs of iron needle legs and a jaw of tiny cogs.
stades.adulte: A long armored gear centipede with spiked cog plates, many sharp iron legs, saw-blade mandibles and green crystal lights between segments.
stades.ancien: An ancient gear centipede with worn and rusted cogs, oil-stain markings, a long wire whisker beard and a slow-spinning brass halo above its head.

fiche: Armure vivante habitée par un vent ensorcelé, elle garde les salles d'armes des forteresses et change d'humeur selon son heaume.
apparence: Empty suit of living steel armor with a glowing blue mist inside visible through the visor and joints; polished steel, deep blue and gold trim.

stades.bebe: A round little helmet with a blue mist face of two big glowing eyes peeking through the visor slit.
stades.enfant: Small floating gauntlets and boots appear around the helmet, connected by wisps of blue mist.
stades.ado: A breastplate joins the pieces into a lanky armored body with a short plume on the helmet.
stades.adulte: A towering full plate knight with gold-trimmed pauldrons, a tower shield, a long halberd and blue mist streaming from every joint.
stades.ancien: An ancient battered knight armor with dents and moss, a broken plume, a long mist beard flowing from the visor and a halberd used as a cane.

fiche: Griffon mécanique à rouages d'horloge qui survole les clochers et tient le temps pour les cités des montagnes.
apparence: Clockwork griffin with a brass eagle head, a clock face on the chest and wings made of thin steel feathers; brass, steel silver and white clock face.

stades.bebe: A round brass pocket watch with big eyes, a tiny beak and two little winding-crown feet.
stades.enfant: Two small folding steel wings and a pair of clawed brass legs appear.
stades.ado: The body becomes a feline torso with four legs, a brass eagle head and wings of overlapping steel feathers.
stades.adulte: A majestic clockwork griffin with a large ticking clock face on the chest, wide blade-feather wings, pendulum tail and sharp brass talons.
stades.ancien: An ancient clockwork griffin with cracked clock glass, tarnished feathers, a white-metal beard tuft and floating clock hands circling its head.

fiche: Flaque de métal en fusion animée par une étincelle de magie, elle rampe dans les forges et se façonne selon ses envies.
apparence: Blob of molten liquid metal that shapes itself into tools, with a floating forge crystal at its core; glowing orange copper, dark iron crust and red crystal.

stades.bebe: A small round droplet of glowing copper with two big eyes and a cooled dark crust cap on top.
stades.enfant: Two stubby molten arms pull out of the blob and a red crystal glows in its center.
stades.ado: The blob grows taller and forms one arm into a hammer shape, with dark iron crust plates floating on its surface.
stades.adulte: A large molten metal mass with hammer and blade arms that reshape at will, a crust armor shell and a blazing red crystal core.
stades.ancien: An old molten blob mostly cooled into dark iron, with a dripping metal beard, glowing cracks and an anvil-shaped crown.

fiche: Machine runique en forme de drake, forgée par des mages oubliés pour patrouiller le ciel au-dessus des tours d'arcane.
apparence: Drake-shaped runic machine of dark steel plates engraved with glowing violet runes and crystal-sail wings; dark steel, violet rune glow and copper.

stades.bebe: A round steel egg with a tiny horned head, big violet eyes and a single glowing rune on its belly.
stades.enfant: Four short clawed legs and a little segmented tail appear, with runes lining its back.
stades.ado: Two copper frame wings with thin violet crystal panels unfold and copper horns sweep backward.
stades.adulte: A sleek runic drake with armored steel plates, wide crystal-sail wings, a rune-carved jaw breathing violet light and a bladed tail.
stades.ancien: An ancient runic drake with faded runes, copper patina, chipped crystal wings and a floating ring of glowing rune glyphs around its neck.

fiche: Golem colossal bâti à partir d'un rempart entier, il protège les vallées et peut rester immobile des siècles.
apparence: Giant golem built of fortress wall bricks and battlements, bound by iron chains, with a glowing amber crystal heart; sandstone, iron black and amber.

stades.bebe: A single round brick with big amber eyes, two pebble feet and a tiny battlement crown.
stades.enfant: Stacked stone arms appear on the sides and an iron chain wraps its waist.
stades.ado: The body grows into a tower of bricks with thick pillar legs, an iron gate mouth and an amber crystal in the chest.
stades.adulte: A colossal walking rampart with tower shoulders, battlement crown, huge brick fists wrapped in iron chains and a blazing amber crystal heart.
stades.ancien: An ancient fortress golem overgrown with ivy and moss, crumbling battlements, a beard of hanging vines and tiny birds nesting on its shoulders.

fiche: Machine à vapeur bestiale à chaudière vivante, elle arpente les terres volcaniques et souffle des nuages brûlants.
apparence: Rhino-like steam engine construct with a riveted boiler body, chimney horns and piston legs; copper, black iron and white steam with orange furnace glow.

stades.bebe: A small round copper kettle with big eyes, a spout nose puffing steam and four tiny wheel feet.
stades.enfant: Short piston legs replace the wheels and a little chimney horn appears on its head.
stades.ado: The body becomes a riveted boiler barrel with a glowing furnace door mouth and two chimney horns.
stades.adulte: A massive steam beast with a riveted boiler body, triple chimney horns blasting steam, heavy piston legs and a roaring furnace jaw.
stades.ancien: An old steam beast with soot-blackened copper, a beard of dripping condensation pipes, patched rivets and a gentle steam halo.

fiche: Marionnettiste de porcelaine noire qui flotte dans les théâtres hantés, tirant les fils de petites poupées à son service.
apparence: Floating black porcelain doll construct with a cracked mask face and many silver strings controlling tiny puppets; black porcelain, silver and violet crystal.

stades.bebe: A round black porcelain head with a white smiling mask, big violet eyes and one silver string above it.
stades.enfant: A small floating dress body and two thin porcelain hands holding a tiny wooden control cross appear.
stades.ado: Four slender arms appear, each holding a control cross with a small dangling puppet on silver strings.
stades.adulte: A tall elegant floating marionettist with a flowing black porcelain gown, six arms with silver strings, three dancing puppets and a violet crystal in its mask.
stades.ancien: An ancient cracked porcelain marionettist with golden repair seams, a long silver veil like a beard, and a halo of crossed control bars.

fiche: Souverain de tous les constructs, ce titan-forge vit au cœur des volcans éteints et donne vie à chaque machine d'un coup de marteau.
apparence: Colossal titan of bronze and steel with a living forge in its chest, an anvil crown and floating energy crystals; bronze, steel and bright cyan crystal glow with orange forge fire.

stades.bebe: A small round bronze anvil with big cyan eyes, a tiny hammer tail and a flickering fire spark on its head.
stades.enfant: Short steel arms appear, one holding a little hammer, and a small furnace window opens on its belly.
stades.ado: The body grows into a broad bronze knight shape with bellows shoulders, a glowing forge chest and three small floating crystals.
stades.adulte: A colossal bronze titan with an open roaring forge in its chest, an anvil crown, a giant runic hammer and a ring of cyan energy crystals orbiting its shoulders.
stades.ancien: An ancient forge titan with deep cracks glowing orange, a long beard of braided copper cables, relic tools hanging from its belt and a radiant crystal halo.
